info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Summarys-v2-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Summary API provides an overview of the items currently in a user's shopping cart. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve a summary that includes details such as product names, quantities, and total price. It serves e-commerce platforms and applications that need to display cart information to users, offering a seamless shopping experience. Typical users include front-end developers integrating cart refresh functionalities or back-end systems updating user sessions. This API is essential for optimizing user engagement and enhancing online shopping efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current summary of the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current summary of their shopping cart, including items, quantities, and total price. It provides a quick overview for users to see what they have selected before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the summary of the current shopping cart. It contains details about the items in the cart and any applicable discounts or totals.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content to return.
